# react-simple-schema-form

> Generate React forms from JSON Schema (draft-07): $ref, allOf/oneOf/anyOf, if/then/else, dependencies, custom widgets via uiSchema. Zero runtime dependencies beyond React 18+. MIT.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-simple-schema-form
- Source: https://github.com/ssunils/react-simple-schema-form
- Live demo (edit schema + uiSchema, see the form regenerate): https://ssunils.github.io/react-simple-schema-form/

## Docs

- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://ssunils.github.io/react-simple-schema-form/llms-full.txt): README, agent skill, and every example schema in one file
- [README](https://github.com/ssunils/react-simple-schema-form#readme): API, supported keywords, widget precedence, recipes
- [Agent skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/ssunils/react-simple-schema-form/blob/main/skills/react-simple-schema-form/SKILL.md): condensed usage guide for coding agents; also shipped in the npm package under skills/
- [Example schemas](https://github.com/ssunils/react-simple-schema-form/tree/main/examples): $ref, allOf, oneOf/anyOf, if/then/else, dependencies, ui:* hints, widget selection

## Quick start

```tsx
import { SchemaForm } from 'react-simple-schema-form';
<SchemaForm schema={schema} uiSchema={{ bio: { widget: 'textarea' } }} onSubmit={(data) => save(data)} />
```
